source: Notion Lanebound - GDD / Champions v3.0 (gdd/lanebound-champions-v3.0.md); look from champions/portraits/painted/ysol/ysol-1024.png
note: Blue faces right and red faces left on the live map. Anchor is the foot point; blit at (round(sx)-9, round(sy)-23). Hit frames apply damage; projectile_spawn.offset is pixels from the foot anchor. Status follows the shared language: slow = drag at the feet, silence/stun = head plate (spectator/spec.md), root = wicks at the feet, sleep = eye at the head, mark = shoulder pin.

palette.note: Copper bell and ember stay off objective gold #F2C14E; team tint only on the sash ring and one bell-band pixel.

idle.note: slow breath, ember bead drips and re-forms

walk.note: short shuffle under a wide robe, bell bobs

attack.note: bell tick: lift, ring, release an ember note

skill.note: Q Kiln Bell: swing the bell forward, rings open a cone, silence lands on 4

mend.note: W Ember Mending: raise the bell, embers pour to the ally, heal + dispel on 4

ult.note: R Vowbreak: lift the staff, slam the butt down on 5, kiln cracks knock up

death.note: bell drops, kneel, sit back; last frame holds

silence.note: Q: silence plate at the head (ring + slash), shared glyph
silence.name: Kiln Bell

knockup.note: R: body lifted 4 px, shadow stays on the ground, stun plate while airborne
knockup.name: Vowbreak
knockup.priority_band: stun (airborne shares the stun band, spectator/spec.md)

dispel.note: W: the ally status plate cracks and falls, ember ring at the feet
dispel.name: Ember Mending
